material: Buddy Talks AUDIO FILE - cup and bird
lesson.introText:
Hey guys! I’m BUDDY! Today, we’ll work on two vowels that stay merged even in advanced speakers. They’re... …/ʌ/ and /ɝ/! Merging them costs you real minimal pairs: hurt

Compare: bud and bird, cut and curt, hut and hurt. Same consonants. Without the contrast, the listener rebuilds the word from context, every time.
